description: South Tyneside MBC publishes a single payments-over-£500 transparency feed (cloudscraper-fetched from transparency portal, 2015–2025/26). Unitary metropolitan borough with adult social care + children's services responsibility, so feed contains REDACTED Care-Act direct-payment rows mixed with conventional procurement. Default: procurement_paid; REDACTED variants → direct_payment_individual so they don't poison HHI / supplier-league analyses.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR personal-data redactions. South Tyneside CSVs include 'REDACTED PERSONAL DATA' rows (verified in 2019/20 validation sample, Children's Adults & Families Group). Same suffix-tolerant regex as other ASC unitaries (Blackpool, Blackburn, LCC). Excluded from duplicate / split-payment / concentration analyses.
Default for South Tyneside. Single payments feed — no PO/invoice split. ~255K rows covering 2019/20–2025/26.
